name: Atelier UI
summary: Motion and React Three Fiber component system for React and Next.js: WebGL galleries, cursors, scroll effects, page transitions.
description: A copy-in component system (French for workshop) for React and Next.js: background effects, text animations, cursor interactions, scroll effects and page transitions built on Motion, React Three Fiber and Tailwind CSS v4. Components share one WebGL canvas and one smooth-scroll loop, so effects stay aligned to the DOM. Installs are driven by coding-agent prompts that write a SKILL.md per component. 36 components and 7 foundation blocks; free components are MIT, some Pro components need a one-time license key.
contains: 8 background effects, 11 cursor effects, 11 scroll effects, 4 page transitions
